APP DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT

This App Development Agreement is entered into as of June 8, 2026 between Kestrel Digital LLC ("Developer") and Marlowe Fitness Studios, Inc. ("Client").

1. Services. Developer will build a class-booking app for Client and will deliver it by September 30, 2026.

2. Fees. Client will pay Developer $60,000.

3. Ownership. The app is a work made for hire and belongs to Client.

4. Confidentiality. Each party will keep the other party's non-public information confidential.

5. Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Texas.

KESTREL DIGITAL LLC
